title: Newmark Arranges Sale of Four-Building Industrial Portfolio in Silicon Valley
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of The Cadillac Court Industrial Portfolio (“Cadillac Court”), a 302,447-square-foot industrial campus in Milpitas, California.
